concerns.text: FR-017 requires the *same* bias‑correction layer to be applied to both historic and recent datasets, but the only bias‑layer task (T012) generates two separate rasters (bias_layer_historic.tif and bias_layer_recent.tif). No task ensures a single shared layer is used for both periods.

SC-004 mandates reporting data‑acquisition completeness (≥95 % species with ≥100 records after thinning and ≥99 % non‑null climate values). No task in the current list explicitly computes or validates these completeness metrics.
